# Steps (`steps`)

Wizard progress: horizontal or vertical, with complete and error states.

Group: Navigation. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/navigation';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createSteps` (types in `dist/web/navigation/steps.d.ts`): `ol.mh-steps` (`--horizontal | --vertical`) of `li.mh-steps__step` (`.is-complete | .is-current | .is-upcoming | .is-error`, `aria-current="step"` on the current one). Each holds a `.mh-steps__marker` (number, check or alert icon), `.mh-steps__text` (`__label`, `__description`, `__optional`, and the state for screen readers) and, between steps, a `.mh-steps__connector`. With `onSelect`, completed steps are `button.mh-steps__button`s.

```ts
export function createSteps(options: StepsOptions): StepsHandle;

export interface StepsOptions {
  steps: readonly StepItem[];
  /** Index of the current step (0-based); steps before it are complete. Past the end, everything is complete. */
  current?: number;
  /** Default `horizontal`; a narrow container shows only the current step's label. */
  orientation?: StepsOrientation;
  /** Accessible name of the list; default "Progress". */
  label?: string;
  /** Makes completed steps buttons that go back to them. */
  onSelect?: (index: number) => void;
  optionalText?: string;
}

export interface StepsHandle {
  el: HTMLOListElement;
  current(): number;
  setCurrent(index: number): void;
  setSteps(steps: readonly StepItem[]): void;
}

export interface StepItem {
  label: string;
  /** A second line ("Wi-Fi and password"). */
  description?: string;
  /** Marks the step as failed (shown in the danger colour with an alert icon). */
  error?: boolean;
  /** Shows "Optional" under the label. */
  optional?: boolean;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createButton, createSteps } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const items = [
  { label: 'Connect', description: 'Plug in the hub' },
  { label: 'Network', description: 'Wi-Fi and password' },
  { label: 'Rooms', optional: true },
  { label: 'Done' },
];

const steps = createSteps({
  label: 'Hub setup',
  steps: items,
  current: 1,
  // Completed steps become buttons that go back to them.
  onSelect: (index) => steps.setCurrent(index),
});

const next = createButton({
  label: 'Next',
  variant: 'primary',
  onClick: () => steps.setCurrent(Math.min(steps.current() + 1, items.length)),
});

document.body.append(steps.el, next.el);
```

## React API

`Button` (types in `dist/react/actions.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createButton`.

```ts
export function Button({ variant, size, icon, trailingIcon, loading = false, fullWidth, disabled, className, type = 'button', children, ...rest }: ButtonProps);

export interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  children?: ReactNode;
}
```

`Steps` (types in `dist/react/navigation.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createSteps`.

```ts
export function Steps({ steps, current = 0, orientation, label = 'Progress', onSelect, optionalText = 'Optional' }: StepsProps);

export interface StepsProps {
  steps: readonly StepItem[];
  current?: number;
  orientation?: StepsOrientation;
  label?: string;
  onSelect?: (index: number) => void;
  optionalText?: string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Steps } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const STEPS = [
  { label: 'Connect', description: 'Plug in the hub' },
  { label: 'Network', description: 'Wi-Fi and password' },
  { label: 'Rooms', optional: true },
  { label: 'Done' },
];

export function StepsExample() {
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(1);
  return (
    <div>
      <Steps label="Hub setup" steps={STEPS} current={current} onSelect={setCurrent} />
      <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setCurrent((n) => Math.min(n + 1, STEPS.length))}>
        Next
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```
